extension.description: Manage your Vagrant VMs right from VS Code: up, halt, reload, provision, ssh and destroy from the sidebar.
view.welcome:
No Vagrantfile found in the workspace or in global-status.
[Refresh](command:vagrantManager.refresh)
config.vboxManagePath: Path to VBoxManage, used to show CPUs, memory, network and ports for VirtualBox VMs.
config.showGlobalMachines: Also list projects found via `vagrant global-status`, besides the workspace Vagrantfiles.
config.pruneGlobalStatus: Use `vagrant global-status --prune` to remove invalid entries from the index (slower).
config.autoRefreshInterval: Interval in seconds for automatic refresh. 0 disables it.
